NEOW.talk.SHUYU_CHARACTER_SHUYU_CHARACTE: [sine]...kill... the Architect... only then... can you leave...[/sine]
[sine]...take this blessing... find... the way out...[/sine]
Why does everything I gather disappear whenever I come back?
DARV.talk.SHUYU_CHARACTER_SHUYU_CHARACTE: Magic kitty! Come look! I just found a huge pile of shiny magical junk!
Ooh, this one's shiny. I like it...
The magic kitty is back! I left this pile unsorted just for you. Dig through it yourself!
I've noticed you only ever pick the cold things. You really don't want any of the other treasures?
Magic takes focus. And carrying too much on the road is exhausting.
NONUPEIPE.talk.SHUYU_CHARACTER_SHUYU_CHA: Little mage, you came to receive a blessing dressed in such a plain robe?
A casting robe only needs to be warm, stain-resistant, and not cling to fur, meow.
Little mage, come here! I prepared the most marvelous ornaments for your ears.
Earrings get pressed under my hat. They're uncomfortable...
When you become a great mage, everyone will recognize you by your attire.
Shouldn't they recognize me by my magic, scholarship, and research?
Those are all hidden inside. First, you must make people want to look at you.
OROBAS.talk.SHUYU_CHARACTER_SHUYU_CHARAC: A cat?! A cat that does magic! Where does the ice come from? Are your ears cold? Can your tail cast spells too?!
Ah! Don't touch my ears or tail without asking, meow!
Ice kitty is back! Did you bring new spells? Can you make snow? Frost? Frozen treats?!
Why doesn't magical ice melt?! Is it not hot? Or does it stay frozen even when it's hot?!
Because I freeze more than the water. I freeze the flow of magic around it, too.
PAEL.talk.SHUYU_CHARACTER_SHUYU_CHARACTE: Cold little mage... In your hands, perhaps my flesh could be preserved a little longer...
I'll rest for a while too, meow... (...purr...)
Your body is always melting, then growing back. This is no ordinary regeneration magic.
Father shaped us... Changing form is like changing a dream...
TANX.talk.SHUYU_CHARACTER_SHUYU_CHARACTE: Kitten! What kind of weapon is that tiny wand? Get a bigger one!!
It's large enough for ordinary spell experiments, meow. It can also become an ice-shard cannon.
A CANNON?! Make one now! Then fight me!!
The kitten is back! Did you make a bigger weapon this time?!
I made it a little smaller so it's easier to carry, meow.
Apprentice mage, fight me! Let me test your weapons of ice!!
TEZCATARA.talk.SHUYU_CHARACTER_SHUYU_CHA: Oh, what a chilly little darling! Come here and let me warm your ears.
No, thank you. A cat's normal body temperature is higher than a human's, and my ears aren't frosted over.
My little darling is back! I made some piping hot treats. Would you like one?
Little darling, I smell misfortune on you. Have you been secretly studying some forbidden art?
I will strictly limit how often I use it.
VAKUU.talk.SHUYU_CHARACTER_SHUYU_CHARACT: Press your pawprint here, and I can let you skip that long apprenticeship and become a great mage at once.
I'm not lazy enough to sign without reading the contract, meow...
We meet again. What, you still haven't become a great mage?
Research takes time. Especially when a demon keeps trying to tamper with the experimental conditions.
I possess an ice crystal thought extinct. A single fragment would be enough to complete all your research.
I'd rather go ask the Architect...
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SHUYU_CHARACTER_SHUYU: There are so many fascinating magical materials here! And this cold machine core...
No one is permitted to cause trouble here.
You have returned. Was your previous death not clear enough?
I didn't die! I was only temporarily defeated!
What you call magic is merely power stolen from my creations.
I still stole it with talent and hard work, meow!
